info.title: InsureCRM API
info.description: REST API for InsureCRM — a CRM platform for insurance agencies. Manages authentication, client records, and policy tracking.

post.description: Validates required fields, generates a unique claim number (CLM-YYYY-XXXXXXXX), and creates a new claim record with status 'submitted'.

policyNumber.description: Policy number the claim is filed against

incidentDate.description: Date the incident occurred (ISO date string)

estimatedAmount.description: Estimated damage amount in USD (must be positive)

contactPhone.description: Contact phone number for the claimant

400.description: Validation error — missing required fields or invalid estimatedAmount

get.description: Returns a paginated list of claim summaries. Supports filtering by clientId, status, and category.
Returns the full claim record for a given claim number.

patch.description:
Transitions a claim to a new status. Only certain transitions are allowed:
- submitted → under_review, denied
- under_review → approved, denied
- approved → settled
- denied → closed
- settled → closed
- closed → (no transitions)

When approving, an optional `approvedAmount` can be set. An optional `reason` adds an internal system note.

approvedAmount.description: Approved payout amount (relevant when status is 'approved')

reason.description: Reason for the status change (added as an internal note)

post.summary: Add a note to a claim
post.description: Adds a note to the specified claim. Notes can be internal (visible only to adjusters/agents) or external (visible to the claimant).

author.description: Name or ID of the note author

internal.description: If true, note is only visible to adjusters/agents

patch.summary: Assign an adjuster to a claim
patch.description: Assigns a named adjuster to handle the specified claim.

adjusterName.description: Name of the adjuster to assign
